title: C-Mining: Unsupervised Discovery of Seeds for Cultural Data Synthesis via Geometric Misalignment
reasoning: The paper includes a significant focus on 'Normative Reasoning' as a core component of its data synthesis and evaluation. This involves generating instruction-tuning data to evaluate an LLM's alignment with social norms, taboos, and contextual appropriateness, which directly intersects with moral and societal value systems.
